[cols="3,3,5",options="header"]
|===
|Resource |Default keys (X11 keysym) |What it does

|`+keyTurnLeft+`
|`+a+`
|Turn left (anti-clockwise).

|`+keyTurnRight+`
|`+s+`
|Turn right (clockwise).

|`+keyThrust+`
|`+Shift_R+` (pass:c[Right Shift]), `+Shift_L+` (pass:c[Left Shift])
|Thrust.

|`+keyShield+`
|`+space+` (pass:c[Space]), `+Caps_Lock+` (pass:c[Caps Lock])
|Raise or toggle the shield.

|`+keyFireShot+`
|`+Return+` (pass:c[Return/Enter]), `+Linefeed+`
|Fire shot.

|`+keyFireMissile+`
|`+backslash+` (pass:c[Backslash])
|Fire smart missile.

|`+keyFireTorpedo+`
|`+quoteright+` (pass:c[' apostrophe])
|Fire unguided torpedo.

|`+keyFireHeat+`
|`+semicolon+` (pass:c[;])
|Fire heatseeking missile.

|`+keyFireLaser+`
|`+slash+` (pass:c[/])
|Activate laser beam.

|`+keyDropMine+`
|`+Tab+`
|Drop a stationary mine.

|`+keyDetachMine+`
|`+bracketright+` (pass:c[\]])
|Detach a moving mine.

|`+keyDetonateMines+`
|`+equal+` (pass:c[=])
|Detonate the closest mine you have dropped or thrown.

|`+keyLockClose+`
|`+Select+`, `+Up+`
|Lock on closest player.

|`+keyLockNextClose+`
|`+Down+`
|Lock on next closest player.

|`+keyLockNext+`
|`+Next+` (pass:c[Page Down]), `+Right+`
|Lock on next player.

|`+keyLockPrev+`
|`+Prior+` (pass:c[Page Up]), `+Left+`
|Lock on previous player.

|`+keyRefuel+`
|`+f+`, `+Control_L+` (pass:c[Left Ctrl]), `+Control_R+` (pass:c[Right Ctrl])
|Refuel.

|`+keyRepair+`
|`+f+`
|Repair target.

|`+keyCloak+`
|`+Delete+`, `+BackSpace+` (pass:c[Backspace])
|Toggle cloakdevice.

|`+keyEcm+`
|`+bracketleft+` (pass:c[[])
|Use ECM.

|`+keySelfDestruct+`
|`+End+`, `+0+`
|Toggle self destruct. _XPilot's default: `+End+`._

|`+keyPause+`
|`+Pause+`
|Toggle pause mode.

|`+keySwapSettings+`
|-
|Swap control settings. _XPilot's default: `+Escape+` (pass:c[Esc])._

|`+keyChangeHome+`
|`+Home+`, `+h+`
|Change home base.

|`+keyConnector+`
|`+Control_L+` (pass:c[Left Ctrl]), `+Alt_L+` (pass:c[Left Alt / Option]), `+Alt_R+` (pass:c[Right Alt / Option])
|Connect to a ball. _XPilot's default: `+Control_L+` (pass:c[Left Ctrl])._

|`+keyDropBall+`
|`+d+`
|Drop a ball.

|`+keyTankNext+`
|`+e+`
|Use the next tank.

|`+keyTankPrev+`
|`+w+`
|Use the the previous tank.

|`+keyTankDetach+`
|`+r+`
|Detach the current tank.

|`+keyIncreasePower+`
|`+KP_Multiply+` (pass:c[Keypad *])
|Increase engine power.

|`+keyDecreasePower+`
|`+KP_Divide+` (pass:c[Keypad /])
|Decrease engine power.

|`+keyIncreaseTurnspeed+`
|`+KP_Add+` (pass:c[Keypad +])
|Increase turnspeed.

|`+keyDecreaseTurnspeed+`
|`+KP_Subtract+` (pass:c[Keypad -])
|Decrease turnspeed.

|`+keyTransporter+`
|`+t+`
|Use transporter to steal an item.

|`+keyDeflector+`
|`+o+`
|Toggle deflector.

|`+keyHyperJump+`
|`+q+`
|Teleport.

|`+keyPhasing+`
|`+p+`
|Use phasing device.

|`+keyToggleNuclear+`
|`+n+`
|Toggle nuclear weapon modifier.

|`+keyToggleCluster+`
|`+c+`
|Toggle cluster weapon modifier.

|`+keyToggleImplosion+`
|`+i+`
|Toggle implosion weapon modifier.

|`+keyToggleVelocity+`
|`+v+`
|Toggle explosion velocity weapon modifier.

|`+keyToggleMini+`
|`+x+`
|Toggle mini weapon modifier.

|`+keyToggleSpread+`
|`+z+`
|Toggle spread weapon modifier.

|`+keyTogglePower+`
|`+b+`
|Toggle power weapon modifier.

|`+keyToggleCompass+`
|`+KP_7+` (pass:c[Keypad 7])
|Toggle HUD/radar compass lock.

|`+keyToggleAutoPilot+`
|`+h+`
|Toggle automatic pilot mode.

|`+keyToggleLaser+`
|`+l+`
|Toggle laser modifier.

|`+keyEmergencyThrust+`
|`+j+`
|Pull emergency thrust handle.

|`+keyEmergencyShield+`
|`+g+`
|Toggle emergency shield power.

|`+keyTractorBeam+`
|`+comma+` (pass:c[,])
|Use tractor beam in attract mode.

|`+keyPressorBeam+`
|`+period+` (pass:c[.])
|Use tractor beam in repulse mode.

|`+keyClearModifiers+`
|`+k+`
|Clear current weapon modifiers.

|`+keyLoadModifiers1+`
|`+1+`
|Load the weapon modifiers from bank 1.

|`+keyLoadModifiers2+`
|`+2+`
|Load the weapon modifiers from bank 2.

|`+keyLoadModifiers3+`
|`+3+`
|Load the weapon modifiers from bank 3.

|`+keyLoadModifiers4+`
|`+4+`
|Load the weapon modifiers from bank 4.

|`+keyReprogram+`
|`+quoteleft+` (pass:c[` backtick])
|Reprogram modifier or lock bank.

|`+keyLoadLock1+`
|`+5+`
|Load player lock from bank 1.

|`+keyLoadLock2+`
|`+6+`
|Load player lock from bank 2.

|`+keyLoadLock3+`
|`+7+`
|Load player lock from bank 3.

|`+keyLoadLock4+`
|`+8+`
|Load player lock from bank 4.

|`+keySelectItem+`
|`+KP_0+` (pass:c[Keypad 0]), `+KP_Insert+` (pass:c[Keypad Insert])
|Select an item to lose.

|`+keyLoseItem+`
|`+KP_Delete+` (pass:c[Keypad Delete]), `+KP_Decimal+` (pass:c[Keypad .])
|Lose the selected item.

|`+keyTalk+`
|`+m+`
|Toggle talk window.

|`+keyIdMode+`
|`+u+`
|Toggle User mode (show real names).

|`+keyToggleOwnedItems+`
|`+KP_8+` (pass:c[Keypad 8])
|Toggle list of owned items on HUD.

|`+keyToggleMessages+`
|`+KP_9+` (pass:c[Keypad 9])
|Toggle showing of messages.

|`+keyPointerControl+`
|`+KP_Enter+` (pass:c[Keypad Enter])
|Toggle pointer control.

|`+keyToggleRecord+`
|`+KP_5+` (pass:c[Keypad 5])
|Toggle recording of session (see recordFile). _Not in JXPilot._

|`+keyPrintMessagesStdout+`
|`+Print+`
|Print the current messages to stdout.

|`+keyTalkCursorLeft+`
|`+Left+`
|Move Cursor to the left in the talk window.

|`+keyTalkCursorRight+`
|`+Right+`
|Move Cursor to the right in the talk window.

|`+keyTalkCursorUp+`
|`+Up+`
|Browsing in the history of the talk window.

|`+keyTalkCursorDown+`
|`+Down+`
|Browsing in the history of the talk window.

|-
|Swap scalefactor settings.

|===

Default control settings: power 45, turnSpeed 40, turnResistance 0.12; alternates altPower 35, altTurnSpeed 25, altTurnResistance 0.12.
